newsitem.title: USA: US June S&P 500 ends up sharply at new record high.
newsitem.headline: US June S&P 500 ends up sharply at new record high.

text.p: May 5 - U.S. stock index futures ended sharply higher, with June S&P 500s at a new record high. June surged through former resistance at 823.60 and old high of 827.80 to reach 838.00.
Technicians say breakout points to more gains. One chartist pegged resistance at 841.00-842.00 and 855.00-857.00.
